messages:
maya: Early-morning nightly eval spike — 3 suites failed for rdl-model-v2 (int4). Marking P2 for now.

maya: Failing suites: instruct_short_prompts, fin_numbers_cohort_v3, safety_assertions_small. First alert at 03:12 UTC. See alert UI: https://console.redwood/evals/alerts/3332109876 :rotating_light:

ci-bot: alert created (id=ae3f9). auto-attached eval artifacts and first 20 examples.

oliver: I'll take initial owner. pulling artifacts now.

oliver: quick sanity: int4 bring-up rolled to staging yesterday, but this run used the new KV-cache tuning. tagging @sanjeev to check kernel/quant rollout.

sanjeev: ack. looking at kernel selection logs — no compile failures. will diff the kernel list vs yesterday.

tara: sample from instruct_short_prompts shows truncated reasoning and nonsense final step. pasted sample: ```
Q: Summarize the meeting notes in 2 bullets.
A: 1) Ran the tests. 2) The cat walked => final: 42.
```

leo: that's consistent with a prefix truncation in the batcher or a KV-cache misindexing. last week we saw similar after smallbatch changes.

oliver: pulled the eval payloads: 37/100 instruct_short_prompts had early stop token, 19/50 in fin_numbers show magnitude hallucination (e.g., $3.7B -> $37B), safety_assertions had anchor slips (policy labels flipped). attaching snippets in the UI.

maya: priority checklist: 1) reproduce locally (oliver), 2) confirm whether int4 vs fp16 diverges (sanjeev), 3) rollback KV-cache tuning for next run (leo), 4) mark run as noisy and notify downstream owners (maya).

oliver: repro steps: ran nightly-eval job with model variant rdl-model-v2:int4+kv-tuned, used the archived promptset v2026-03-19. small script: ```bash
eval-run --model rdl-model-v2 --quant int4 --kv-tuned --suite instruct_short_prompts --out /tmp/out.json
```

oliver: locally I can reproduce the truncated outputs when enabling --kv-tuned + small batch size < 8. disabling kv-tuned yields baseline behavior.

sanjeev: kernel diff shows a fallback to the new attention kernel (opt-attn-v3) for sequence lengths < 128 with kv-tuned enabled. that kernel had an off-by-one in the pointer math in the earlier PR — I rolled back the patch in a dev branch but it may have made it into the tuning matrix.

leo: let's not roll back model quantization yet. plan: pin KV-cache tuning to previous matrix for next nightly, run a quick A/B between opt-attn-v2 vs opt-attn-v3 on 200 examples, and if v3 reproduces, revert the v3 change in the runtime.

maya: owners: oliver (triage + repro), sanjeev (kernel/compile diff), leo (runtime rollback + next-night pin), tara (sample-level failure analysis + alert notes). I'll file the incident ticket and link artifacts.

maya: tagging product-safety and platform-alerts so they can prebake communications if this expands. summary will be in the incident ticket. :thumbsup:
